notes.title: New Update: Exciting New Pieces, Music, and More in Marbleous!
notes.content:
In the newest [i]Marbleous![/i] update, we're giving you even more tools to build incredible tracks and enhance your racing experience.

[list]
[*][b]New Horizontal Track Pieces[/b]: Unlock five brand new horizontal pieces to create even more dynamic and challenging circuits for your marbles.
[*][b]New Funnel Piece[/b]: Add a thrilling funnel element to your tracks, this new piece have two funnels to join in a one path.
[*][b]Epic Music for Race Mode[/b]: Pump up the action with a brand new, high-energy epic track that will get your marbles racing!
[*][b]Relaxing Music for Build Mode[/b]: Take your time and enjoy a calm, lo-fi new tune as you craft the perfect course for your marbles.
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've polished up the gameplay with various bug fixes for a smoother experience.
[/list]

The Marbleous! track-building system continues to evolve, giving you more creative freedom to design, race, and share tracks with friends. Whether you're in the heat of a race or designing the perfect challenge, this update makes it all the more exciting. Ready to race? The podium awaits!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356500/Marbleous/
